verdict.rationale: The skills bundle offers only glancing bulk-style workflows. One skill splits a spec into many small tickets in one pass, the triage skill sorts raw issues and external PRs through a shared state machine, and the whole skill set installs in one command. Nothing shows a deliberate capability to act on many existing items at once. missing for 10: an explicit bulk/batch operation over many issues or files, documentation of batch semantics, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
